purpose: Ten quick shape studies after owner rejected concept 01; ceiling camera only, reduced detail

prompts.name: Стрела
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. ONE SMALL ROUGH TOP-DOWN GAME SPRITE. Match the provided Emergency Shift reference's pale pink flesh, thin dark outline and ivory bone leg tips, but invent a different silhouette. CRITICAL CAMERA: CEILING CAMERA DIRECTLY OVERHEAD AT 90 DEGREES, orthographic floor plan, looking straight onto the creature's BACK. The animal's entire longitudinal axis and all legs lie HORIZONTALLY ON THE FLOOR, like a beetle seen from a ceiling. Travel direction is to the RIGHT of the canvas, NOT up toward the viewer. We see ONLY the top skin surface of the back and top surfaces of limbs; NEVER see chest, belly, upright face, front-facing mouth, standing body, vertical legs or side walls. No face at all: mouth and eyes are on the UNDERSIDE and therefore INVISIBLE from this camera. Use an asymmetrical running contact pose with every foot spread onto the same XY floor plane. NOT a front-view monster portrait, not an emblem, not isometric. Broad FLAT pink shape fills with one restrained darker tone, no texture, veins, muscle fibers, glossy balls, highlights or volumetric rendering. Keep complete attached anatomy, simple connected bent legs, generous negative spaces. Isolated actual transparent background, no floor, cast shadow, glow or text. SILHOUETTE BRIEF (interpret 'front/up' as the travel direction to the RIGHT): Very narrow triangular ARROWHEAD body pointing up with a deep concave rear edge. FOUR long thin jointed running legs swept BACK from the two sides, like two open rearward chevrons. no head or neck, no separate tail. Bold arrow silhouette.
